## Validation and limits

- The six screened development records were all retrieved: **100% relative recall against the development set**. This is not independent validation or absolute sensitivity; no held-out set was available.
- Small-sample and simulation blocks were tested but left out of the final AND search to preserve recall. Their 30-record loss samples found no eligible records, but the samples are weak evidence given how rare eligible papers are. Screen those criteria.
- The count uses the harness-mandated PubMed **Entry Date** cutoff of 2017-11-29. No publication-date (`[dp]`) filter was applied.
